text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (...Left... leg.)

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister?
text_block_list.text: —If you're saying you can't do that...

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister?
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, fall down to the same 
depths as me, Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (According to that dream...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(...My legs won't break down until after 
the Kikuka Sho.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...If that's what you want to do, I don't 
mind, really.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(As a punishment, it's probably just 
right.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(As punishment for failing to offer 
complete glory, for not fully atoning for 
my sins, surely――)

I hurry over to her. ...Ever since before 
the Kikuka Sho, she's rejected me every 
time I've tried to talk to her.

However, it was all too clear that the 
situation no longer permitted optimism. 
...Admire Vega showed far too heavy signs 
of exhaustion.
choice_data_list:
You're pushing yourself too hard, 
Ayabe...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...It's outside your supervision hours, 
Trainer. What I do on my own free time is 
my business, isn't it?

Even during free time, if it concerns 
health management, that's a whole 
different story.

On top of being prone to strain due to a 
congenital misalignment, excessive 
training has pushed it to its breaking 
point. ...Her left leg must already be at 
its absolute limit.
choice_data_list:
Anyway, as soon as we get back, we need to 
treat that—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Stop it. ...Don't get in my way.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You're supposed to just "follow along on 
your own," aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Where I go shall be your path, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, don't stop my legs.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Because I'm heading towards the place I'm 
meant to be...!"
choice_data_list:
...Achieving your goals is important, you 
know.

text_block_list.text:
Supporting an Umamusume's dream is what a 
Trainer does. Of course I want to cherish 
her goals together with her.
However—
choice_data_list:
Just as much as that, you yourself are 
important too.

You yourself are just as important as 
that, you know.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ngh, ...stop it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Don't you dare... say a word about me...!!

Left behind in the cold without a second 
thought. ...A rugged mountain trail. The 
sun had set long ago.

"A strangely nostalgic situation, almost 
like recalling the moment we first met—and 
yet."
choice_data_list: No way I'm losing sight of you again!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *huff*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: K-Kh...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(It hurts... It hurts, it hurts, it 
hurts.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Still... having it hurt a little might 
just—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ugh—

text_block_list.name: Commentator?
text_block_list.text:
The one claiming a spLendiD victory is 
'XXXXXXX'! 'XXXXXXX'! CheErs of blessing 
are eChoIng throughout Kyoto Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (...Thirty-nine times. Ah, again.)

text_block_list.name: Spectators?
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH!! "XXXXXXX"! "XXXXXXX"! 
"XXXXXXX"! "XXXXXXX"!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (That dream again—)

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister?
text_block_list.text: Ahaha—ahahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister?
text_block_list.text:
That was fun, so much fun! I feel on top 
of the world!! Ah—
...It was so much fun, Big Sis.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

Sorry for crying back during the Pony Cup. 
When I thought that might be the last time 
I'd ever run, I just got so lonely...

Even so, Big Sis kept on running. For my 
sake... she ran so, so much.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Big... sis...?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (No way... No. How could this happen...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You are... You are... my...!!

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I was able to debut in the 
Twinkle Series! I even got to run in GⅠ 
races and the Classic Triple Crown races!

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text:
It was fun. ...All of it, truly, was so 
much fun.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text: And yet, why—

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text:
...Why did you apologize back then, Big 
Sis?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...... B-But! I...... went and forgot 
all about you......!

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text:
Even so, you have nothing to apologize 
for. ...I told you, didn't I? I had fun 
the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text:
No, I think even more so after entering 
the Classic class. Because—

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text:
Because we got to have fun "Together with 
Big Sis"!

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text:
I had fun, and I was so happy. Happy that 
you, Big Sis, were able to enjoy the race 
to the fullest with all your heart.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text:
Top Road-san, Opera O-san, and everyone. 
Your races against so many rivals really 
got my heart racing.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't to make amends to me, but 
because you ran with your own true 
feelings, big sister. For me—more than 
anything, that made me so happy.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text:
"...You know, Sis, the truth is... 
Everything you've done for me up until 
now... none of it was out of atonement."

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text:
"Because Big Sis was never to blame in the 
first place."

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text:
So you see... Everything up until now— was 
a present I received from you, Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text:
The thrill of galloping on turf, the joy 
of competing, those heated moments with my 
rivals. And every single memory of 
enjoying racing together!

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text: That's why... That's why...

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to do one thing to thank you in 
return.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text:
—I'll be taking "destiny" for myself, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh— Des... tiny...?

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text:
My sister's soul and mine are two halves 
of one. It's always been that way. That's 
why the fate engraved upon us is the same.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text:
I will take it with me. Along with me, 
that fate――that tragedy will disappear.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: W-Wait. Wait, what are you saying... !?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Disappearing?! Please... Please, don't 
say things like that!!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to do that...! I... I'll 
disappear in your place!

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, fufufu!!

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text: Too baaad, no can do!!

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text: Because—look. Look at your hands, Sis.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hand...? Ah—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Is this... light? ...A hand?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Why... why did you hold on to me—)

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text:
See, look. They're calling out to you with 
all their might.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for everything, all this time, 
forever and always!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ah... w-wait...!

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text:
From now on, live as you wish. And be as 
happy as you can possibly be!

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Sister
text_block_list.text: My beloved... my big sister.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "Wait!! Wait, ugh—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Amidst the sea of pure white, I knew 
two had disappeared.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: With the other half of my soul.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —The pain in my left leg...

"She was found unconscious in the woods, 
an ambulance was called, and she was 
rushed to the hospital—"

How many times during that ordeal did I 
call out to her... as she tossed and 
turned in feverish nightmares?

When she finally regained consciousness, 
the moment she glanced towards me—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ............It disappeared.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: My sister... vanished...!

And then, Admire Vega clung to me and 
wept. She cried and cried, endlessly.

Her fingertips dug into the arm she clung 
to, sending a slight pang of pain through 
it, but—

Surely, that couldn't even begin to 
compare to a fraction of the pain she 
herself was feeling.
